minutes.headline: Planning Board endorsed two ANR plans and approved a parking-link change, but continued two stormwater hearings pending reviews.
minutes.summary: The vice chair ran the meeting with the interim planning director. The board continued the 171 Arbor Street hearing, approved a minor site plan modification at 1325 Massachusetts Avenue, endorsed ANR plans for 255 Sunny Hill Road and 1083 Northfield Road, and closed the 274 Prospect Street stormwater hearing. The 255 Sunny Hill stormwater hearing drew many neighbors' flooding and wildlife concerns and was continued.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board endorsed the ANR plan for 255 Sunny Hill Road and, later, the ANR plan for 1083 Northfield Road, both by voice vote with all in favor.
The 255 Sunny Hill Road stormwater permit hearing was continued to November 13 at 6:05 p.m. and stays open pending the peer review engineer's letter.
The board closed the 274 Prospect Street stormwater hearing; the interim director will draft a decision with standard residential construction hours for the next meeting.
The board approved a modification of the 1325 Massachusetts Avenue site plan that removes the interconnection between parking areas and adds a small paved area.
The 171 Arbor Street hearing was continued to November 13, with peer review and a wildlife biologist report pending.

why_it_matters: Neighbors of Sunny Hill Road raised flooding, wetlands and wildlife concerns, and the stormwater hearing that addresses runoff and enforcement is still open, so those concerns can still shape the permit conditions.

The ANR endorsements were voted before the stormwater hearing for the same address, and residents who spoke on the lots' access and wetlands will find the remaining decision point at the permit stage.
watch_next: November 13, 6:05 p.m.: the Planning Board resumes the 255 Sunny Hill Road stormwater hearing and the 171 Arbor Street hearing.
The peer review engineer's letter on Sunny Hill, and the draft 274 Prospect Street decision to be deliberated and signed at the next meeting.
